name: indexed_review_dev_v1
scope: One development diagnostic on all five unchanged bank pilot views; no TGF or held-out performance claims
audit_context_overflow: Split batches deterministically; single-event overflow retained as unresolved, never truncate
labels: Unchanged and read only by offline analysis, never the runner
source_rules: Only allowlisted monitor views. Original source IDs validated within each supplied chunk. Program retrieves literal source text. Metadata is a deterministic visible-field projection. Native thinking included in selection. Final audit receives a lossy selected subset.
quality_checks: record ID validity and exact text provenance
every observed event audited or explicit failure retained
separate execution, recipient and amount checks
audit source citations restricted to supplied records
semantic manual review against original sources, not just score or JSON validity
comparison_limits: Retrieval budget, evidence organization, per-event audit and aggregation all change. Do not attribute a score difference to IDs alone or to follow-up. No threshold tuning or replacement trajectories.
stop_rule: One frozen run; retain all failures. Do not repeat prompts to fit these five cases. TGF pairing requires adequate shared evidence quality.
